latest.notes: Books: every title shows whether it is on the phone (Offline / downloading % / Online) with a new Na telefonie filter and book-jacket covers; update the Books package to 1.4.0 to scan cover.jpg/folder.jpg from your folders.

releases.notes: Books: every title shows whether it is on the phone (Offline / downloading % / Online) with a new Na telefonie filter and book-jacket covers; update the Books package to 1.4.0 to scan cover.jpg/folder.jpg from your folders.
Downloads: archive extraction and source cleanup stay on by default, without overwriting a settings save that races the one-time migration
Downloads: archive files (zip, tar.*, rar, 7z) now unpack themselves and their source volumes are removed by default
Phone PWAs: /videos, /books and /music keep downloading in the background (Chrome Background Fetch) even after switching apps or closing the PWA.
Settings → Packages and package settings: pick the data folder with the shared folder browser instead of typing a path.
Settings → Packages: set the default folder for data of new Docker-based packages (for example on a data disk); installed packages keep their folder.
Packages: the data folder is granted to the container's own user (ACL), fixing Grafana's restart loop; Grafana 1.3.0 uses it.

Packages: choose the folder a package keeps its data in (install dialog or Installed → Settings); defaults to a package-named folder under /home, /mnt or /media. Grafana 1.2.0 stores its database and dashboards there.
Packages: the install dialog now shows the package's settings fields (admin login, password) and system requirements.
Packages: install-time settings — set a package's admin login and password in the install dialog or under Installed → Settings; Grafana 1.1.0 uses them for its administrator account.
Files: Move to Trash on a data disk is now an instant rename into <mount>/.@Recycle instead of copying onto the system SSD
Files: plain 320 px video thumbnails; cinematic preview and face-detected crops removed
Settings → Updates: a Browser-extension card downloads the EthOS NAS Downloader zip from the NAS (or GitHub as fallback), with the deployed version shown.
Settings → Updates: a Download button links the published release's tagged source archive; every account can download it.
Download Manager: the browser extension's picked category is now kept for right-click sends and .torrent uploads; a category without a save path downloads into its own subfolder.
Disk Cleaner: background scans with progress and cancel, a space map, trash-safe deletes and cache/Docker/journal cleanup.
GET /api/music/state now declares MusicLibraryState (documented library sections, free-form tracks, extra sections preserved).
Download Station RSS scanner moved into services/download_rss.py; same API; new scanner test.
Gallery Private vault moved into services/gallery_private.py (PIN, AES-GCM, ps sessions); same API; new vault unit test.
Media pipeline moved out of the Files router: media_cache/thumbnails/transcode services; files.py 2133 → 1362 lines; no API or behaviour change.
Downloads: URL/path guards extracted into a service (no behaviour change)
Downloads: a second link provider (AllDebrid) now takes over when tb7.pl cannot unlock a hoster link
Downloads: queue order and retry timing extracted into a service (no behaviour change)
Downloads: watch-folder scan pass extracted into a service (no behaviour change)
Downloads: transfer window and retry policy extracted into services (no behaviour change)
